identity.description: DataForSEO is a SaaS provider of SEO and SERP data via REST APIs, used to build SEO software, data pipelines, and no-code automations.
identity.identity_notes: docs.dataforseo.com and dataforseo.com describe the same product (SERP, keywords, backlinks, on-page, etc.), matching the assignment hint.

auth.token_refresh: None. Credentials are static; docs say no separate authentication call is needed to obtain credentials.
auth.scopes_notes: No scopes. Credentials are an API login and an auto-generated API password sent via HTTP Basic auth (Base64). No OAuth flow found in the auth docs.

access.production_restrictions: Live calls are billed pay-as-you-go from account balance. The $1 signup credit covers only a limited number of calls; the MCP pricing page lists a $50 minimum top-up. Sandbox is free but returns dummy data. No provider app review found.

resources: SERP (Google, Bing, YouTube, Yahoo, Baidu, Naver, Seznam)
AI Optimization (LLM Mentions, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity)
Keywords Data (Google Ads, Bing Ads, Google Trends, Clickstream)
DataForSEO Labs (Google, Amazon, Google Play, App Store)
Business Data (Business Listings, Google, Trustpilot, Tripadvisor)
api.limitations: Task-based asynchronous model for many endpoints; live calls cost money. Rate limits not established.

open_questions: Whether a paid plan/top-up is needed beyond the $1 trial for ongoing test work was not confirmed; the MCP page cites a $50 minimum top-up.
Remote MCP endpoint is inconsistent across sources: https://mcp.dataforseo.com/v3/mcp (setup) vs https://mcp.dataforseo.com/mcp (FAQ).
Canonical official repo name is inconsistent: github.com/dataforseo/mcp-server-typescript (guides, verified as DataForSEO-owned) vs npm package dataforseo-mcp-server.
OAuth, token, and SSO support were not found; auth looks Basic-only.
Full list of write operations and exact endpoint breadth not verified beyond the docs homepage.
